messages:
Maria (CSM): @Priya quick sync? HearthLab flagged onboarding latency last week and asked for SLO confirmation + any credit eligibility. They want a short summary for legal before renewal. :wave:
Priya (Onboarding): On it. I saw a few spikes around Wed 03:20 UTC. I'll pull the warm-start traces and the onboarding runbook notes.
Raj (Support): I already attached the incident logs to the ticket — short snippet below:
```
span_id=onb-xyz latency_ms=1180 route=/generate model=redwood-2q cohort=onboard
error_rate=0.0 note="warmup thundering" 
```
Raj (Support): No errors, just high tail latency during a warm restart window. Ops Bot: Incident 2024-05-08T03:17 -> autoscaled; average p99 latency 1.15s for onboarding bucket.
Priya (Onboarding): Thanks. I'll extract the prefix cache hit rates and the KV cache warmup timeline. If it's warmup-only, that usually doesn't trigger credits per policy, but we need to confirm the contract wording.
Josh (AE): Renewal touchpoint next Tue. Customer is nervous about SLA adherence and wants a concrete comms doc + numbers. Can CS provide "what happened" + mitigation + whether a credit applies?
Sam (Sales): For the comms, they want a line that reassures them we fixed root cause and what we'll do to avoid recurrence. Also want the credit calc if applicable. I can soften messaging but need exact figures.
Maria (CSM): Proposed approach: 1) short incident summary (1-2 bullets), 2) latency evidence (dashboard screenshot + p50/p95/p99 during window), 3) remediation steps (cache warmup tweak + staggered restarts), 4) credit decision & calculation if >SLO breach. Does that sound good? :thumbsup:
Raj (Support): I can generate the p50/p95/p99 numbers and attach Cloudtrace spans. Quick stats: p50=120ms, p95=420ms, p99=1150ms during the 30m window. Outside window p99 ~ 220ms.
Priya (Onboarding): I'll draft the remediation notes and propose a change to the onboarding rollout script to stagger model server restarts.
Ops Bot: Suggested search query: `service:inference AND cohort:onboard AND timestamp:[1717488000 TO 1717776000]` — returns 18k requests, grouped heatmap attached in ticket.
Maria (CSM): Credit threshold check: contract says credits apply when uptime < 99.9% or sustained p99 > 800ms for >1 hour. We had p99>800ms but only for 30 mins -> likely no credit, but we should confirm with legal.
Sam (Sales): If legal says no credit, we'll still offer a goodwill one-time account credit to ease renewal. Need finance approval — I'll loop them in once we have numbers.
Josh (AE): Can we have the one-pager by EOD tomorrow? I'll tell the customer we have a formal summary ready by then.
Priya (Onboarding): EOD tomorrow works. I'll include: timeline, root cause hypothesis (cache cold start + restart overlap), remedial action, and short FAQ for the customer.
Maria (CSM): Great. Action items: Priya = draft doc + attach stats; Raj = generate p50/p95/p99 CSV + trace links; Sam = prep credit wording; Josh = lead renewal comms; Maria = final review & send to customer + legal cc.
Raj (Support): Adding ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-4822
Priya (Onboarding): Draft done by 17:00 PT tomorrow. Will ping thread when posted.
Maria (CSM): Perfect — thanks team. If legal flags credit eligibility, we'll reconvene. :white_check_mark:
